metadata.title: Pricing — Fyxio
metadata.description: Full custom website builds from €699. Transparent pricing, fixed fees, and flexible launch options.

sections.heroSubNote: Starting prices. Final scope depends on what you need — scoped before any work starts.

sections.packagesTitle:
One-time build.
You own the result.
sections.packagesNote: Prices are starting points. Final scope depends on page count, content, launch setup, editing needs, and special features. If you already have content ready, projects can move very fast.

packages.subtitle: Simple website, fast launch
packages.desc: For small businesses that need a clean, modern site quickly.

packages.subtitle: More complete, more polished
packages.desc: For companies that want a stronger, more complete website with better structure and a more polished first impression.

packages.subtitle: Custom scope
packages.desc: For businesses that want a more refined, more impressive, and more custom website experience.

sections.launchTitle:
Choose how you want the site
handled after build.
sections.launchBody: Some clients want everything managed. Others want to own the accounts with a clean handover. Technical teams can take the code and handle the rest.
sections.domainNoteSub: We only help connect it to the new site.

options.title: Managed for you
options.desc: We host, launch, and maintain everything. You edit your own content anytime through the included editor — no code, no developer needed.
features: Edit your own content via the editor
options.note: Best if you do not want to deal with GitHub, Vercel, DNS, or technical setup.

options.title: Client-owned setup
options.desc: You own the hosting and code accounts. We set everything up and connect the site properly.
features: Setup on your own GitHub / hosting account
options.note: One-time fee. Best if you want long-term ownership but still want us to handle the technical launch.

options.title: Code handover
options.desc: We deliver the website code and documentation. Your team handles hosting, deployment, and maintenance.
options.note: Best if you already have a developer or technical team.

sections.ongoingTitle:
Editing, hosting, and updates
are flexible.
sections.hourlyDesc: Text edits, image swaps, new sections, new pages, and other content work can also be handled for you at an hourly rate.
sections.aiSessionBody: A focused hands-on session where I set up Claude Code or Codex in your project and teach you how to make major changes yourself — to your site or anything you want to build.
aiSessionFeatures: Claude Code or Codex setup in your project
Live walkthrough — you follow along and build
Learn to make big changes without a developer
Works even if you have never written code before
Covers how to add pages, sections, and features
Foundation for building your own sites later
aiSessionPrereqs: Active Claude or ChatGPT subscription — you'll be using the tools directly
AI tool installed on your laptop before we start

ongoing.label: AI-ASSISTED EDITING
ongoing.title: Editor + AI
ongoing.body: Upgrade your included editor with AI support for rewriting, improving, and adjusting your website content whenever you want.
features: Best for clients improving content over time

sections.scopeNotSureTitle:
Tell me what you need.
I'll keep it simple.
sections.scopeNotSureBody: Send a short brief and I'll recommend the simplest setup for your situation — without pushing unnecessary tools or complexity.
factors: Whether content is ready or needs editing
Amount of custom design and animation
